nodes.title: director26: 16 lessons (4 pilots x 4 rule-based children) on integration 79 (521801aa5, release 46), model joins off, 1,621 calls, $1.14, four Opus judges by hand. Gate: c5-t01 passes; c4, c6, c5-t02 fail. Contradictions 1, 0, 0, 1 and unsaid boards 1, 0, 2, 2 (c4, c5-t01, c5-t02, c6): all six rows one mechanism (a remediation's help wording drawn over the skill's first check card's board). 0 misgrades in 253 verdicts; 0 false keys. Axes d25 to d26: listening 4, 3.5, 3.5, 4 (was 3.5, 3, 3, 3.5); register 3.5, 3.5, 3, 3.5 (was 3, 3, 3, 3.5); promises 4, 3.5, 3.5, 3.5; screen and speech 3.5, 4, 3.5, 3.5. Help turns with nothing new 1, 0, 0, 0 (d25: 3, 5, 5, 1); no help sentence repeated in about 150 help turns; keys with a wording unsaid 0; paraphrasing second wordings 16 help turns. Turns over 60 words 44 of 675; steady rows 131, 133, 161, 117; check-ins tedious to 3 of 4 judges (worked-example step turns); 61-to-75-word turns monologue to 1 of 4. Model-written sentence heard 4 times, all the stop menu. Hints making a question trivial or untrue of the board 6 (c4 2, c5-t01 4). The safety turn did not occur (the line 'no place' was not said). The run's own helpBoard predicate read 0 on the six rows.

After director26. B1: the help function returns the board with the wording and nothing downstream replaces it; a remediation's help is over the remediation's own board, and one with no board keeps the board that is up; every remediation gets a board. B2: a child who wants to stop gets the authored line, never a model draft. C1: a worked example's told steps go two to a turn within 75 words with one check-in (steps authored at 30 words or fewer); no check-in after a verdict when the next part fits; measured on the dry matrix before release (steady lessons at most 22 check-ins and no run of more than two back to back outside the child's own requests, else the break of turns without a card is dropped as director26's clause 4 first said). J1: the go-on line only after a key, and never with another joint at the seam; a beforeWorked joint. N1: no request gets nothing: with no part recorded the part is the last part said; the model drafts no teaching turn. R1: 'said once' counts each remediation, not each mix-up. A4, W1 and the script list. Reverse: B1 on any wrong board in director27 (help turns then carry their own page built by the help function); C1 if the dry measure fails or two judges still find check-ins tedious (drop the break, steps in one turn); N1 on any request met with nothing (the walk refuses to end the turn); R1 if a remediation is said twice or for a mix-up not shown (count goes back to the mix-up); register below 3.5 in two topics: the cause with most rows gets the round.

helpBoard was written and tested on the director25 rows, as dc-r8-director25 required, and read 0 on all six director26 rows where four judges found help over the wrong board: the director25 rows were a remediation's line said after its board had moved on, the director26 rows are a remediation's help borrowing a card's board. A predicate proved on one run's rows is proved for that run's mechanism. The rule is stated as an invariant the code enforces (the page builder throws in a test run when a help page's board is not the one the help function returned), with the predicate as its reader, not its only guard.

The help rebuild (one function reading the said set, dc-r8-director25 H4) did what three rounds of patches (H1, H2, H3) did not: help turns with nothing new fell from 14 to 1 across 16 judged lessons, with no sentence repeated in about 150 help turns and no key given while a wording was unsaid. What remains is authored wording (second wordings that restate the first) and the board on one path.

Open teaching question after director26: worked examples are told to the child, who does one step at the end; judges in director24, 25 and 26 list it under what a parent would still find wrong, and the step turns' check-ins are where the tedium is. Candidate: each told step ends on a small question of its own with a verified key, so the check-in becomes work. Changes the script format and the walk; waits until four topics pass the gate as it stands.
